login.title: Admin login
login.subtitle: Sign in to manage IT Mart
login.forgotPasswordSubtitle: Enter your admin email and we'll send you a reset link.
login.resetLinkSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link has been sent. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
login.resetSuccess: Password reset successfully. Redirecting you to login...
login.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired.

analytics.subtitle: Revenue trends and top-selling products
analytics.incompleteCostData: Some products don't have a cost price set yet, so this profit figure is a partial estimate. Add cost prices in the product form for a fuller picture.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Manage your product catalog
products.dragImages: Click to upload or drag images here
products.costPriceHint: What you paid for this item — internal only, never shown to customers.
products.discountPriceHint: Optional — fill in only if this item is on sale. When set, this is the price charged to the customer and used to calculate margin, instead of the normal price.
products.relatedProductsHint: Shown on the product page above "You may also like" — e.g. link a printer to its ink, paper, and cable.
products.duplicated: Product duplicated — edit the copy below.
products.shortDescriptionHint: Shown under the product name, before the price. 1–2 sentences.
products.shortDescriptionPlaceholderFr: Ex. Imprimante 3-en-1 Wi-Fi, idéale pour la maison et le bureau.
products.shortDescriptionPlaceholderEn: E.g. 3-in-1 Wi-Fi printer, ideal for home and office.
products.variantOfHint: For different models sold as separate products (e.g. 8 GB / 16 GB RAM): type the same model name on each. For colours or sizes of one product, use "Variants" below instead.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Organize your catalog into categories
categories.imageHint: Shown on the storefront's homepage category grid.
categories.typeColorHint: Shown as a clickable color circle on the storefront — customers pick the color before adding to cart.
categories.orderHint: This is the order the characteristics appear in on the product page. Use ↑ ↓ to change it.
categories.hiddenThirdLevel: ⚠ Not visible on the shop: it sits under a subcategory. Edit it (✎) and choose a main category as its parent.

banners.subtitle: Manage the homepage hero banner(s)
banners.hint: The first active banner (by sort order) is shown as the homepage hero. Add more than one to rotate through several.
banners.placementHint: Choose which spot on the storefront this banner is for.
banners.imageHint: Main banner: 1500 × 600 px (5:2). This shape is the same on phones and computers: a 5:2 image fills the banner perfectly everywhere. Other shapes are shown in full, with blurred edges.
banners.placementSide: Tile to the right of the main banner (GIF allowed)
banners.imageHintSide: Side tile: about 600 × 350 px. Animated GIFs are accepted (5 MB max) and stay animated. Shown on computers only (hidden on phones). Up to 2 tiles per side.
banners.imageHintTile: The image is shown in full inside the tile.
banners.placementSideLeft: Tile to the left of the main banner (GIF allowed)

deliveryZones.subtitle: Set delivery fees per city — shown to customers at checkout
deliveryZones.hint: Customers pick their city from this list at checkout, and the matching fee is added to their order total automatically.
deliveryZones.cityHint: Must match exactly what you want customers to see (e.g. Yaoundé, Douala).
deliveryZones.sortHint: Lower numbers appear first in the checkout dropdown.

account.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.

admins.subtitle: Manage who can access this dashboard
admins.hint: Only Super Admins can see this page and manage other admin accounts.
admins.cannotDeleteSelf: You can't delete your own account.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Track and manage customer orders
orders.invoiceFailed: Could not generate the document. Please try again.

pwa.title: IT Mart on your phone
pwa.intro: Install the admin as an app and get an alert on this device for every new order and low stock.
pwa.iosHint: On iPhone: tap the Share button in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen".
pwa.installManual: Open the browser menu (⋮) and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
pwa.notifBlocked: Blocked — allow notifications for this site in your browser settings.
pwa.iosInstallFirst: On iPhone, install the app to your Home Screen first, then turn on notifications from the app.
pwa.insecure: Installing the app and notifications need a secure connection (HTTPS, or localhost on this computer). See the README for testing on a phone.
pwa.bannerTitle: Get new orders on your phone
pwa.bannerText: Install the app and turn on notifications.
pwa.offline: You are offline — changes can't be saved until the connection is back.

errors.serverNotConfigured: Notifications aren't configured on the server yet (VAPID keys missing in the backend .env).
errors.permissionDenied: Permission refused. Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings.
errors.generic: Couldn't turn on notifications. Please try again.

variants.title: Variants (colours / sizes)
variants.hint: For one product available in several colours and/or sizes. Each variant has its own stock; the customer chooses on the product page. Leave empty if the product only comes in one version.
variants.sizeLabelHint: Shown to customers. Leave empty for "Size".
variants.none: No variants: the product is sold in a single version, with the stock shown on the right.
variants.quickHint: One variant is created for each colour × each size, with a stock of 0. You then fill in the quantities.
variants.stockFromVariants: Worked out automatically: total of the variants' stock.
variants.errorEmpty: Variant {{n}}: enter a colour and/or a size.

settings.subtitle: Facebook Pixel, Google Analytics, Google Ads and Clarity
settings.trackingIntro: Paste each tool's ID here (or the whole code it gives you: the ID is picked out automatically). A tool left empty is off. No code changes needed.
settings.extracted: ID picked out of the pasted code.
settings.delayNote: Changes show on the shop within a minute.
settings.consentHint: Recommended. The tools only load after the visitor clicks "Accept".
settings.consentWarning: Without the banner the tools load for every visitor. Cameroon's 2024 personal data law, and Meta's and Google's rules, generally expect visitor consent.

meta.label: Meta Pixel (Facebook / Instagram)
meta.purpose: Measures sales coming from your Facebook and Instagram ads, and lets you retarget visitors.
meta.where: Events Manager → Data sources → your Pixel → ID (digits).
meta.invalid: The Pixel ID contains digits only (e.g. 1234567890123456).

ga.label: Google Analytics 4
ga.purpose: Visit statistics: how many visitors, where from, pages viewed, products sold.
ga.where: Admin → Data streams → Web → Measurement ID (G-…).
ga.invalid: The measurement ID starts with G- (e.g. G-AB12CD34EF).

ads.label: Google Ads — ID
ads.purpose: Counts sales coming from your Google ads.
ads.where: Goals → Conversions → your "Purchase" conversion → Set up the tag → "AW-…".
ads.invalid: The Google Ads ID starts with AW- followed by digits (e.g. AW-123456789).

adsLabel.label: Google Ads — "Purchase" conversion label
adsLabel.purpose: The part after the slash in send_to: 'AW-123456789/XXXX'. Paste the tag code: both fields fill in by themselves.
adsLabel.where: Same place as the Google Ads ID.
adsLabel.invalid: The label only contains letters, digits, - and _.

clarity.label: Microsoft Clarity
clarity.purpose: Heatmaps and recordings of visits: see where visitors click and scroll.
clarity.where: Your project → Settings → Overview → Project ID.
clarity.invalid: The Clarity ID contains lowercase letters and digits (e.g. k2x9abc1de).

branding.subtitle: Your shop's logo and colours
branding.intro: Make the shop yours with your logo and colours. They apply to the whole site (buttons, prices, header, footer) and to invoices, with no code changes.
branding.logoHint: Shown at the top of the site, in the footer and on invoices. A transparent PNG in landscape format works best (3 MB max).
branding.iconHint: Small square image: browser tab and phone home-screen shortcut. Ideally your logo's symbol, without text.
branding.darkHint: "Buy" button, titles, banners and footer. Pick a dark shade.
branding.lowContrastPrimary: Very light main colour: white text on buttons will be hard to read. Pick a stronger shade.
branding.lowContrastDark: Dark colour too light: titles and white text on banners will be hard to read. Pick a darker shade.

store.subtitle: WhatsApp, contacts, social media, invoices
store.intro: Your shop's details, which you can change any time without touching the code. A field left empty uses the old value from the .env file, if there is one.

sections.contactHint: Used by the floating WhatsApp button, product questions, orders and the footer.
sections.socialHint: An icon appears at the bottom of the site for each link filled in.
sections.notificationsHint: Where should we tell you about new orders and low stock?
sections.invoicesHint: Details printed at the top and bottom of invoices and proformas.

whatsappNumber.label: Shop WhatsApp number
whatsappNumber.hint: Country code + number, no + or spaces (e.g. 237690000000). Orders and customer questions arrive on this number.

contactPhone.label: Phone shown
contactPhone.hint: Optional. If empty, the WhatsApp number is shown.

contactEmail.label: Contact email
contactEmail.hint: Optional. Leave empty if you don't have a professional address yet: it won't be shown.

facebookUrl.label: Facebook page
facebookUrl.error: The link must start with https://

instagramUrl.label: Instagram account
instagramUrl.error: The link must start with https://

tiktokUrl.label: TikTok account
tiktokUrl.error: The link must start with https://

notificationEmail.label: Email that receives alerts
notificationEmail.hint: A copy of each new order and low-stock alerts (on top of the app notifications).

lowStockThreshold.label: Low-stock level
lowStockThreshold.hint: Alert when a product's stock drops to this number or below.

vatRate.label: VAT rate (%)
vatRate.hint: 0 if you don't charge VAT. In Cameroon the standard rate is 19.25%.

invoiceFooter.label: Note at the bottom of invoices
invoiceFooter.hint: E.g. payment terms, bank or Mobile Money details.
